title: THE NUE
subtitle: the monster in the black cloud
source: Heike monogatari, Book 4 'The Nightbird' (Yorimasa, Ino Hayata, Emperor Konoe, Shishio); Nue Shrine and Nue Pond, Nijo Park, Kyoto; White's thrush (toratsugumi) called 'nue'

lines.say: [sly] You asked for the Nue.
[scared whisper] Kon... what is that sound?
[low] Pray it's a bird.
[ominous] Over 850 years ago, a black cloud crept over the Emperor's palace every night.
At 2 a.m., something inside it began to cry.
The Emperor fell ill. Priests prayed. Nothing worked.
So they called the best archer in Japan: Minamoto no Yorimasa.
cap: So they called the best archer in Japan:

lines.say: He brought two arrows. The second was for the man who recommended him... in case he missed.
cap: The second was for the man

lines.say: He prayed, drew his bow, and aimed into the dark.
[intense] One arrow.
[intense] Something shrieked and fell out of the sky.
cap: and fell out of the sky.

lines.say: His retainer Hayata leapt on it and finished it.
cap: His retainer Hayata leapt on it

lines.say: Then they raised the torches.
The face of a monkey. The body of a tanuki. The legs of a tiger. A snake for a tail.
[horrified] Monkey face, TIGER legs, SNAKE tail?!
The Emperor recovered. Yorimasa was rewarded with the sword Shishio.
The pond where he washed his arrow is still in Kyoto, next to the Nue Shrine.
cap: The pond where he washed his arrow

lines.say: [hushed] And its cry? It sounded like a night bird Japan still calls the nue.
[whisper] You can still hear it.
[terrified] Kon... that one didn't sound like a bird.
cap: that one {r:didn't} sound like a bird.
